hook.name: EtherealFactory
hook.description: Token launch factory (Ethereal.fun) that creates ETH/token Uniswap v4 pools with one-sided liquidity burned to 0xdead. Charges ETH fees on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, with an anti-snipe decay from 30% to the creator's base rate over the first 24 seconds; fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims and are split between the creator and the platform.
